reviews.name: Eamon Shahir
reviews.text:
Managed over 500k of our ad spend this year for taxd.co.uk. Have been working with Ben and domi search for nearly 3 years. A true expert in his space. Taxd has grown a phenomenal customer base thanks to our fantastic google acquisition strategy. 

The important thing here is that Ben will spend the time to really understand the business and the metrics behind the scenes. This will be fed into the whole process from start to finish. He is not recognised as just an agency but more of a partner.

I recommend Ben to all of my business contacts and would be happy to provide a reference to any business out there.

reviews.name: Arjun Kumar
reviews.text: Ben started off helping Taxd with our social media and email campaigns. He was great to work with, instantly understood us as a brand and company so when we needed additional support with Google Ads too it was a no brainer. We started to get Ben's support on more areas of the Google Ads process including landing pages and copy too. This massively helped us increase conversions at each stage of the funnel, more clicks from ads, more conversions from those clicking etc. Overall the results we have seen with Ben has been great. What we truly appreciate too, is Ben's ability to provide insights, suggestions and execute independently.
